Business Unit
Cloud & Smart Industries Group (CSIG) is responsible for promoting the company's cloud and industry Internet strategy. CSIG explores the interactions between users and industries to create innovative solutions for smart industries via technological advancements such as cloud, AI, and network security. While driving the digitalization of retail, medical, education, transportation and other industries, CSIG helps companies serve users in smarter ways, building a new ecosystem of intelligent industries that connect users and businesses.

What the Role Entails
Position Overview
Tencent Cloud International & Smart Industries Group (CSIG) is seeking a Developer Marketing & Ecosystem Manager based in London to support the growth of Tencent Cloud’s developer ecosystem and global marketing initiatives.
In this role, you will focus on planning and executing developer engagement programs, working closely with HQ product and product marketing teams, research and analyst teams, as well as regional marketing and sales teams. You will help amplify Tencent Cloud’s developer tools and solutions, drive awareness and adoption, and grow our developer ecosystem.
You will also support the execution of key international marketing events, contributing to developer engagement and business growth across regions.
Key Responsibilities
1. Developer Marketing & Ecosystem Development
Plan and execute developer engagement programs to grow Tencent Cloud’s developer ecosystem
Work closely with product, product marketing, and research teams to promote developer tools (APIs, SDKs, platforms) and drive adoption
Identify key developer segments and tailor engagement approaches based on developer behavior, platforms, and regional insights
Build and support developer communities, including both third-party platforms (e.g., GitHub, Discord, etc.) and Tencent Cloud’s own developer programs
Support initiatives such as hackathons, meetups, workshops, and content programs to engage developers and increase participation
Contribute to messaging and positioning aligned with AI and cloud technology trends

2. Field Marketing & Event Execution
Support the planning and execution of international events, including trade shows, exhibitions, and developer-focused activities
Coordinate with regional marketing, sales, and HQ teams to ensure smooth execution
Support event content preparation, onsite delivery, and post-event follow-up
Help drive developer engagement, lead generation, and ecosystem growth through events

Who We Look For
Requirements
3–5 years of experience in developer marketing, ecosystem programs, or B2B tech marketing
Strong understanding of developer audiences, platforms, and community dynamics
Familiarity with developer ecosystems (e.g., GitHub, open-source communities, developer forums)
Technically savvy, with good understanding of cloud technologies and AI landscape
Experience in event marketing or program execution is a strong plus
Strong cross-functional collaboration skills, with the ability to navigate stakeholders and coordinate resources effectively
Experience working across regions and cultures in a global organization

Language & Location
 Based in London
 Fluent English is required
 Mandarin is highly preferred for collaboration with HQ teams
 Additional languages (e.g., Spanish, Portuguese) are a plus

What We’re Looking For
 A hands-on executor with strong ownership and attention to detail
 A strong collaborator who can work across regions, teams, and stakeholders
  Someone who is proactive, resourceful, and able to operate in a fast-paced environment
  Passion for developers, AI, and technology ecosystems

Equal Employment Opportunity at Tencent
As an equal opportunity employer, we firmly believe that diverse voices fuel our innovation and allow us to better serve our users and the community. We foster an environment where every employee of Tencent feels supported and inspired to achieve individual and common goals.
Work Location: UK-London
